rows.definition: The declared multi-goal execution plan `goalrunner.FleetPlan` (internal/goalrunner/types.go), an ordered set of GoalContracts run serially by `RunFleetPlan`, which records per-contract witness evidence and a rollup (`SerializePlanJSON`, `RenderRollup`).
rows.distinction: The goalrunner FLEET-of-goals serial plan - NOT the swebench fleet RUNNER planner `FleetPlanner`/`newFleetPlanner` (which builds one swebench code planner from a gateway address) and NOT the debtlane CAMPAIGN plan `WavePlan` (debt lanes into concurrent-safe waves).
